metadata.description: Claude Code mods by Wojciech Kucha

plugins.name: lucid
plugins.description: Restrained, readable transcript for dark and light terminals: warm greys, one accent, AA contrast, quiet tool rows. A mouse selection pastes rendered prose and code lines exactly as written; for the markdown source use ditto.

plugins.name: ditto
plugins.description: Copy what Claude wrote as raw text: reply markdown, code blocks, tables, files Claude read or wrote, plans and tool output, by hover chip or /ditto

plugins.name: mermaid
plugins.description: Draws mermaid sequence diagrams from Claude's replies as text in the terminal
